info.title: Planou agent API
info.description: Rotas /v1 dos agentes (snake_case). Gerado pela API (scripts/openapi.sh); os plugins testam o Planou falso contra este arquivo.

title.description: The name of the behavior in plain Portuguese (frontmatter title of the BEHAVIOR.md); without it the Papel tab shows the technical name.

summary.description: One sentence of what the behavior does (frontmatter summary of the BEHAVIOR.md); without it the Papel tab shows the description.

layer.description: The layer of the role: rules, instructions, skill or memory; another value is ignored. The Papel tab shows the behavior in that layer (skill when absent).

kind.description: always (loaded every session) or on_demand (an index line in the load, read when used); another value is ignored. The Papel tab shows it as the seal sempre or sob demanda.

options.description: The options of the behavior in behavior_config.json, by key (letters, digits and . _ : -, up to 60). type: text, bool, int, choice or command (read only in the Papel tab); an unknown type is ignored.

content.description: The text of the file, with sha256 of exactly this text: only on the editable kinds (instructions, context, behavior_config; up to 200 KB) and on lessons (read only, this agent's recent days, up to 32 KB; the Papel tab shows each lesson with its state from the [..] prefix).

title.description: Only on kind behavior: its name in plain Portuguese, as in the catalog.

summary.description: Only on kind behavior: one sentence of what it does, as in the catalog.

excerpt.description: Only on kind memory: its first lines (the handoff summary of the previous session), up to 6 lines and 600 characters. Not kept in confidentiality minimum or when it looks like a credential.

autonomy.description: The agent's autonomy (its config): what it does on its own, what it asks before and what it never does, up to 30 phrases of up to 200 characters each. Shown read only in the Rules layer of the Papel tab; not kept in confidentiality minimum.

plugin_self_update.description: auto: the provisioner of this computer brings this copy to the published version by itself (the installer's archive copy, or its clean git clone on main). Otherwise why not: disabled (auto_update false), no_provisioner, development (not the installer's copy), no_git, not_own_repo, other_remote, other_branch, local_changes (a tracked file changed), local_commits (a commit origin lacks), untracked_conflict (an untracked file where the new version brings one).
